consumer_contract.fragment_encoding: UTF-8 bytes in bound reader, no normalization
consumer_contract.internal_links: Fragments inherit the bound reading document as their base URI; do not silently retarget cross-references.
consumer_contract.styles: Use the bound reading document style or its verified equivalent. Fragments alone are not standalone pages.
consumer_contract.answer_policy: Question view excludes the entire source-answer container; answer IDs and access links remain explicit.
consumer_contract.reuse: Resolve the same unit ID against source LaTeX, this English reader, or the native Indonesian edition.
consumer_contract.code_execution: Historical transcripts only; mathematical replay does not certify vendor runtime.
consumer_contract.answer_absence: not_supplied_by_original_source is distinct from not_rendered; an answers view for such an exercise is empty and must not fabricate an answer.
consumer_contract.table_cells: The hash-bound sidecar maps native table IDs to one-based source row/column locators, exact source byte spans, mathematical region IDs and nested table IDs; it does not invent native cell IDs.
consumer_contract.editorial_notes: Retain the separate applicable source findings in unit and answer views, without modifying the pinned original or leaking answer-only notes into questions.
